instruction: Please implement an innovative platform that integrates artificial intelligence and blockchain technology. The platform should have functionalities such as data analysis, intelligent recommendations, and secure authentication. Users should be able to register and log in to the platform, upload data, view analysis results, receive intelligent recommendations, and conduct secure transactions. The platform should have multiple data visualization methods, including charts, maps, and more. Define background as pale goldenrod; define components with dark khaki.

Please implement a mobile game website for players to engage in role-playing, strategic challenges, and social interactions. The website should have functionalities such as character development, combat system, social interaction, mall system, and challenge instance. Players should be able to create characters, upgrade character levels, unlock skills and equipment, participate in real-time battles, develop battle strategies, make friends, team up to challenge instances, purchase in-game items and equipment, and communicate with other players through the in-game chat system. Use light yellow for the background and dark khaki for components.

Please implement an EspoCRM website that integrates n8n.io functionality for workflow automation. The website should have functionalities for adding n8n.io nodes, embedding an iframe within the EspoCRM dashboard, and automatic login to n8n.io. Users should be able to access n8n.io's features within EspoCRM, create and manage workflows, and monitor workflow execution. Use pale goldenrod for the outer layout and dark khaki for UI blocks.

Please implement a simple web application to display "Hello World". The user should be able to access the website and see the "Hello World" text. The website should have a homepage that displays the "Hello World" message. The user should be able to refresh the page and see the same information. Establish light salmon as the main background and tomato for the controls.

Please implement a mobile guestbook website for users to leave and view messages. The website should have functionalities for leaving messages, viewing messages, and deleting messages. Users should be able to log in, input message content, submit messages, view all messages, delete their own messages, and reply to messages. Assign ice blue as the background color and apply teal to all elements.

Please implement a WeChat mini-program mall for selling various products. The mall should have functionalities for browsing products, adding to cart, placing orders, and making payments. Users should be able to log in, browse products, add selected products to the cart, place orders for selected products, and make payments. Define the background as light goldenrod and components as goldenrod.

Please implement an ERP system for the electronics manufacturing industry to manage various business processes. The system should include customer relationship management, inventory management, financial management, production management, production scheduling, material requirements, production BOM and substitute materials, outsourcing management, inventory management, inventory management, after-sales management, project management, administrative personnel management, simple salary management, logistics and express management, and shared document management. Users should be able to log in to the system, browse and manage related data, and perform business operations, such as creating and managing customer information, managing inventory, creating and managing production orders, etc. Color the background using buttermilk and set component styles to peru.

Please implement an email migration website to transfer emails from SiteGround to Gmail. The website should have functionalities for migrating emails, setting up folders and labels, and auto-forwarding messages. Users should be able to log in, select the email accounts to be migrated, set up the target Gmail accounts, and configure auto-forwarding rules. The website should also provide tutorials or guides to help users understand how to set up Gmail SMTP and other related features. Implement styling with dust white for the background and forest green for components.

Please implement a network asset management and security platform for managing and monitoring network assets. The platform should have functionalities for unit management, asset management, security monitoring, notification handling, and message notification. Users should be able to log in, manage basic unit information and accounts, query unit information, apply for and modify unit assets, perform security monitoring and vulnerability management, handle notifications and security incidents, and receive message notifications. Choose feather white for the background; set all component colors to dark green.

Please implement a freelancer platform website to connect employers and freelancers. The website should have basic features such as messaging, bidding, and project management. Users can register as either employers or freelancers, post projects, bid on projects, communicate with other users, and manage project progress. The website should also have a user center for displaying personal information, project records, and account management. Define the background as light salmon and components as tomato.

Please implement a marine academic social and knowledge service platform that provides knowledge resources and academic social services. The platform should have functionalities for knowledge services, academic social networking, operation management, and information services. Users should be able to browse and search for knowledge resources, participate in academic discussions, manage their personal knowledge libraries, and receive personalized knowledge recommendations. The platform should also provide paid services, including the purchase of books, articles, and specialized libraries. Set all pages to have a apricot background and chocolate components.

Please implement a website that embeds RSS information into articles and pages. The website should have the functionality to manage RSS information, including adding, deleting, and editing RSS sources. Users should be able to choose from different display options, such as list, grid, or card layout, and customize the displayed content, such as title, summary, and publication time. The website should also have flexible configuration options to match the website's style. Color the background using bisque and set component styles to dark salmon.

Please implement a website that showcases the features and applications of PHP. The website should have functionalities for introducing the basic characteristics, syntax, and application areas of PHP. Users should be able to browse information about the history, features, advantages, and common application scenarios of PHP, and view related code examples and development cases. Use lavender blush for container backgrounds and deep pink for component visuals.

Please implement a web application based on the MVC programming paradigm, with user registration, login, browsing, and management functions. Users should be able to register an account, log in to the system, browse different sections of content, and manage their own account information. The system should have a clear navigation menu, making it easy for users to find the functions they need. Configure the background color to morning fog, with components using dim gray.

Please implement an online photo gallery system for displaying and managing pictures. The system should have functionalities for uploading, deleting, editing, and categorizing. Users should be able to log in, browse, upload, and manage their own pictures, create albums, edit picture information, and share albums with other users. Declare old lace as the global background color and tan for all UI pieces.

Please implement a web application for automating numerical data entry. The application should be able to automatically input numerical data, and users should be able to upload numerical data files or manually input numerical data. The application should also have data validation and error handling capabilities to ensure data accuracy and integrity. Users should be able to view and edit entered data and export data to various file formats. Assign navajo white to body backgrounds and sienna to main components.

Please implement a database design assistance system to aid in database design and management. The system should have functionalities for database design, common field definition, modification history saving, automatic SQL generation, and database table synchronization. Users should be able to import and export database definitions, manage field-level histories, manage database synchronization identifiers, and display modification records in a timeline format. Design the site using almond as the background and sienna for content blocks.

Please implement a mini-program editor for editing and displaying mini-program pages. The editor should have functionalities such as sign-in, preview, and membership. Users should be able to edit mini-program pages online, including adding images, text, and graphics, and support AI capabilities such as image cutting and brush removal. Users should be able to preview the edited pages and save or publish the mini-program. Choose cool gray for the background; set all component colors to charcoal.

Please implement a love note mini-program for sending and managing love-related messages. The mini-program should have functionalities for sending love notes, viewing received notes, and managing sent notes. Users should be able to log in, send love notes to other users, view notes they have received, and manage notes they have sent. Use lavender mist for the outer layout and dark orchid for UI blocks.

Please implement an IPTV channel live stream website for playing live channels. The website should have functionalities for browsing channels, playing live streams, and searching channels. Users should be able to browse different types of live channels, select and play channels of interest, search for specific channels, and view detailed channel information. Design the site using turquoise as the background and cadet blue for content blocks.

Please implement a flight query website to query flight information. The website should have functionalities for querying flight information and displaying flight details. Users should be able to input query conditions, query flight information, and view flight details, including flight number, departure city, arrival city, departure time, and arrival time. Configure the background color to lemon chiffon, with components using olive.
